headline: Archipelago multiworld support and a signed mod index land
summary: Ratchet & Clank gains an Archipelago mod for multiworld play, with defeating Drek as the finish condition. The lock-strafe mod now releases L2 and R2 for hoverboard tricks and resumes strafing after dismounting. A signed mod index and submission tools also landed.
highlights: Archipelago multiworld support includes the game integration package; a release fix adds that package to uploaded assets (#5, #6).
Hoverboard controls remain available while lock-strafe is installed (#4).
The new signed index publishes the mod list, with submission forms, a bot and picture processing (#7).
Repository references now use openrac-mods, and submission workflows act through the organization's bot (#19, #20).
